description: The quote adds "Duties and taxes billed at cost, not included" and the invoice adds duties of $310 as line 9. There is no duties ChargeType, so the line and the exclusion fact both use chargeType "other". With no rate, approval, rejection or permitted surcharge for it, the exclusion rule applies: outside_quote_scope R5 (Cleared). Expected = billed, so agreed rises by $310. FLAG: if extraction typed duties as customs_entry, the $125 customs rate would apply and line 9 would wrongly become R2.
